blocks.text: Let's look at this one. The quantity six times five, times two, equals six times the quantity five times two. Which property does it show?
The numbers are in the same order on both sides: six, five, two. What moved are the parentheses.
Thirty times two is sixty, and six times ten is also sixty. Regrouping is the associative property.
So the answer is the associative property.
Watch out for these traps. It isn't the commutative property, because the numbers stay in the same order. It isn't the distributive property, because there is no sum inside the parentheses.
